{"path":"snake_zai-glm-5.3_01.html","edit_description":"Create this file from scratch: a complete, self-contained classic Snake game (HTML + CSS + JavaScript all inline in one file, no external resources, works offline). Follow this spec precisely:

LAYOUT & STYLE (CSS in <style>):
- Dark neon theme: page background dark navy (#0b1220-like), centered game column, system font stack.
- Header: game title "SNAKE", current mode label, controls hint line.
- HUD above canvas: two score panels — left panel for Snake 1 (green #4ade80 accent), right panel for Snake 2 (blue #38bdf8 accent) — each showing player name, score (food eaten) and length, with colored left border and subtle glow.
- Stage: 600x600px canvas (30x30 grid, 20px cells), crisp rendering via devicePixelRatio scaling, rounded border with glow. Footer line with key summary.
- Three overlays absolutely positioned over the stage, toggled via a .hidden class:
  1. START MENU: big title "🐍 SNAKE", subtitle, three mode buttons — "1 · Human vs Human", "2 · CPU vs Human", "3 · CPU vs CPU" — clickable AND selectable with keys 1/2/3, plus a small controls legend (P1: WASD, P2: Arrow keys, P: pause).
  2. GAME OVER: "GAME OVER" heading, winner line ("Player 1 wins! 🏆" / "CPU wins!" / "It's a draw!"), final scores of both snakes, hint "ENTER / SPACE / R — restart · M — menu".
  3. PAUSED: "PAUSED" + "press P to resume".

GAME LOGIC (single <script>, 'use strict', clean commented code):
- Constants GRID=30, CELL=20.
- Snake class: name, color, isCPU, body = array of {x,y} with head at index 0, dir {x,y}, input queue (max 2 entries; setDir ignores duplicates and 180° reversals relative to last queued/current dir), score. nextDir() shifts queue.
- Global state: 'menu' | 'playing' | 'paused' | 'over'; mode: 'hh' | 'ch' | 'cc'.
- startGame(mode): snake1 cells (7,15),(6,15),(5,15) facing right; snake2 cells (22,14),(23,14),(24,14) facing left; length 3, scores 0. Modes: 'hh' both human (snake1 WASD, snake2 arrows); 'ch' snake1 human accepting BOTH arrows and WASD, snake2 CPU named "CPU"; 'cc' both CPU named "CPU 1"/"CPU 2". Spawn food, reset timers, hide overlays, state='playing'.
- Food: single red glowing food on a random empty cell (never on any snake). Eating: +1 score, snake grows (tail kept), respawn food; if board full, eating snake wins.
- Game loop: requestAnimationFrame with time accumulator; tick interval starts 110ms, decreases 2ms per total food eaten, min 75ms.
- Tick procedure (compute ALL deaths before applying any moves):
  1. For each snake compute new head: human uses nextDir(); CPU uses cpuDir(). Never reverse 180°.
  2. Eating flag: new head lands on food.
  3. Deaths: (a) wall = out of 0..29 bounds; (b) self-hit: new head in own body EXCLUDING own tail cell when not eating this tick; (c) hit other snake's body with the same tail-exclusion rule; (d) head-to-head: both new heads on the same cell → both die; (e) head-swap: A's new head equals B's current head AND B's new head equals A's current head → both die.
  4. Apply: unshift new head; if eating keep tail (score++, respawn food) else pop tail.
  5. If any snake died → state='over', show game-over overlay: survivor wins, or draw if both died simultaneously.
- CPU AI cpuDir(snake):
  - Obstacles = all cells of both snakes EXCEPT the AI snake's own tail (it vacates).
  - BFS shortest path head→food avoiding obstacles; if found and the first step is in-bounds, not deadly (deadly = out of bounds or on any snake cell except tails that vacate), and flood-fill reachable area from that step ≥ snake length + 2 → take that step.
  - Else survival mode: among the 3 non-reversal directions take the immediately-safe ones, compute flood-fill reachable area for each, pick the largest (tie-break: smaller Manhattan distance to food); if none safe keep current dir.
  - Helpers: inBounds(x,y), cellKey(x,y), bfsPath(start,goal,blockedSet) returning the first-step cell, floodFill(start,blockedSet) counting reachable cells (grid is only 900 cells).
- Keyboard (window keydown): always preventDefault for arrows and space; in 'menu': 1/2/3 start modes; in 'over': Enter/Space/R (case-insensitive) restarts SAME mode, M/Escape returns to menu; in 'playing': P toggles pause (on resume reset the accumulator so no catch-up tick), direction keys mapped per mode ('hh': WASD→snake1, arrows→snake2; 'ch': both→snake1; 'cc': ignored).
- Rendering every frame: background, faint grid lines, pulsing glowing food (animate with timestamp), snakes as rounded-rect segments with brighter head with two small eyes oriented by direction and body alpha fading toward tail.
- HUD DOM updated each tick: names, scores, lengths; mode label and controls-hint text per mode (hh: "P1: WASD · P2: Arrow keys"; ch: "You: Arrows / WASD · CPU: AI"; cc: "CPU battle — sit back and watch").

Target ~500-600 clean lines, English comments, no external fonts/libraries/images."}
